confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Italian price levels; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates, which swing with Sardinian summer demand. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to beer because direct local bar pricing knowledge is weak. The fx observation (2026-10-15, 0.6955) comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates page; I could not open the F11.1 table, and other results showed an older RBA snapshot, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Italian regional capitals with similar restaurant and hotel price levels, such as Bari and Palermo, with a July accommodation uplift for Sardinian summer demand.
